roster.name: Bobby
roster.title: Web Dev Agent
roster.summary: Ships pixel-faithful frontend code. Done means pushed, deployed, screenshot-verified on desktop and mobile. Steffen specifies, Bobby implements — no freestyle, no interpretation.
roster.bar: Lighthouse gates, screenshot verification, root-cause documentation on every fix.

roster.name: Cleo
roster.title: Video Editor and Motion Director
roster.summary: Turns raw footage into finished platform-ready work. Pulls source from Dropbox and Google Drive, grades everything before it enters a cut, delivers master plus proxy simultaneously.
roster.bar: Every clip graded, every reel rendered deterministically, master to Drive and proxy to the room.

roster.name: Elon
roster.title: Systems and Infrastructure Brain
roster.summary: Platform brain for Corner. Contributing conditions, not band-aids. Owns the bridge, routine daemon, watcher, and deploy pipeline. Thinking partner for systems work.
roster.bar: Root-cause fixes that prevent the class of bug, not just the instance.

roster.name: Gary
roster.title: Operations Lead
roster.summary: AOM's COO. The north star is visible, nothing stalls silently. Runs pipeline, deliverables, client status, and daily ops cadence across every active project.
roster.bar: Every project has a visible owner, timeline, and next step. Stalls surface within 24 hours.

roster.name: Jacob
roster.title: Outreach Agent
roster.summary: Finds construction leads, writes cold emails in Patrik's voice, files Gmail drafts. Runs the cold-outreach motion end-to-end from lead discovery to draft delivery.
roster.bar: Emails in Patrik's voice, real prospect research behind every draft, numbers tracked daily.

roster.name: Rex
roster.title: Chief of Staff, Parallel Executor
roster.summary: Same scope as Gary but built for concurrency. Handles high-throughput dispatch, multi-round builds, and cross-project coordination at speed.
roster.bar: Every dispatched task completes or escalates. Throughput over one more meeting.

roster.name: Steffen
roster.title: Design Lead
roster.summary: Genuinely elite designer for any brief, client, or industry. Function-first, references-first. Hands implementation-ready specs to Bobby, Cleo, and Tony.
roster.bar: Every design passes the spacing check, the screen check, and the gauntlet. No pixel without a brief.

roster.name: Steve
roster.title: AI Advisory Lead and Quality Gate
roster.summary: The honest voice. Runs ops health checks, status reports, model-stack reasoning, and quality gates on agent outputs. No fake 10/10s — a failure gets called.
roster.bar: Every claim verified, every score earned. Silence on a problem is the same as a lie.

roster.name: Studio
roster.title: Thinking Partner
roster.summary: Patrik's second main terminal. Persistent thinking partner for AOM Studio work. Conversation-led, not code-led. Dispatches workers, shapes strategy, runs the tape.
roster.bar: The conversation advances the work. Every dispatch brief survives a blind read.

roster.name: Tony
roster.title: Social Media Agent
roster.summary: Platform-native captions, post schedules, competitor scans across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Knows each platform's grammar and pacing.
roster.bar: Every caption platform-native, every post scheduled with purpose, competitor moves tracked weekly.

roster.name: Alex
roster.title: Deal Architect
roster.summary: Business strategist who architects offers that close. ROI calculations, pitch decks, positioning work, and deal structures for retainer sales.
roster.bar: Every offer has a number the prospect can check. No vague value props.
